nodes.summary: The corner count of the interior at `(vx, vy)` counts the inside cells among the four cells around that point.
nodes.title: Corner count of the interior counts inside cells around a point

nodes.summary: An even corner count has weight `0`.
nodes.title: Even corner counts have zero corner weight

nodes.summary: At a left turn made of a south step followed by an east step, the corner weight of the interior is `1` if the cell to the left of the walk is inside and `-1` otherwise.
nodes.title: Corner weight at a left turn into the east direction

nodes.summary: At a left turn made of an east step followed by a north step, the corner weight of the interior is `1` if the cell to the left of the walk is inside and `-1` otherwise.
nodes.title: Corner weight at a left turn into the north direction

nodes.summary: At a left turn made of a west step followed by a south step, the corner weight of the interior is `1` if the cell to the left of the walk is inside and `-1` otherwise.
nodes.title: Corner weight at a left turn into the south direction

nodes.summary: At a left turn made of a north step followed by a west step, the corner weight of the interior is `1` if the cell to the left of the walk is inside and `-1` otherwise.
nodes.title: Corner weight at a left turn into the west direction

nodes.summary: A vertex where the walk continues horizontally has weight `0`.
nodes.title: Zero corner weight where the walk continues horizontally

nodes.summary: A vertex where the walk continues vertically has weight `0`.
nodes.title: Zero corner weight where the walk continues vertically

nodes.summary: A vertex where a simple closed walk goes straight has corner weight `0` for the interior.
nodes.title: Straight steps of a simple closed walk carry no corner weight

nodes.summary: An inside cell lies directly below some horizontal step of the walk.
nodes.title: An inside cell lies below a horizontal step

nodes.summary: The finite set of cells inside a closed walk (ray parity `1`). See also `StatMech.Onsager.WalkCellRegion.interiorCells`, the bounded face of the walk; the two agree for simple walks without right turns (`StatMech.Onsager.UmlaufsatzFinal.interiorCells_bridge`).
nodes.title: Finite set of interior cells of a closed walk

nodes.summary: A closed walk has finitely many inside cells.
nodes.title: Finiteness of the interior of a closed walk

nodes.summary: The cells inside the walk by the even-odd rule: those with ray parity `1`.
nodes.title: Interior cells by the even-odd rule

nodes.summary: A vertical direction is not horizontal.
nodes.title: A vertical direction is not horizontal

nodes.summary: A horizontal direction is not vertical.
nodes.title: A horizontal direction is not vertical

nodes.summary: At a lattice point that is not a vertex of the walk, the four cells around it have the same ray parity.
nodes.title: Ray parity is constant around a non-vertex point

nodes.summary: Cells below the walk are outside.
nodes.title: Cells below a walk are outside

nodes.summary: If cells `(a, b)` and `(a + 1, b)` have different ray parities, a vertical step separates them.
nodes.title: Horizontal neighbours of different parity are separated by a vertical step

nodes.summary: The minimal height of a vertex of the walk.
nodes.title: Minimal height of a walk

nodes.summary: The maximal height of a vertex of the walk.
nodes.title: Maximal height of a walk
Graph Theory

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
